title: House fire — escape
text:
1. Raise the alarm — shout and wake everyone. Call the fire station or 911 and give your exact address.
2. Feel closed doors with the back of your hand. If hot, do NOT open — use your second way out or a window.
3. Stay low under the smoke, cover your nose with a wet cloth, and move quickly to the exit. Never use the elevator.
4. If trapped, seal door gaps with wet cloth, stay by the window, and signal with a flashlight or bright cloth.
5. Once out, stay out and gather at your planned meeting point. Never re-enter a burning building.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Fire Safety

title: Sunog sa bahay — pagtakas
text:
1. Mag-ingay — sumigaw at gisingin ang lahat. Tumawag sa bombero o 911 at ibigay ang eksaktong address.
2. Kapain ang saradong pinto gamit ang likod ng kamay. Kung mainit, HUWAG buksan — dumaan sa pangalawang labasan o bintana.
3. Yumuko sa ilalim ng usok, takpan ang ilong ng basang tela, at mabilis na pumunta sa labasan. Huwag gumamit ng elevator.
4. Kung na-trap, takpan ng basang tela ang siwang ng pinto, manatili sa tabi ng bintana, at sumenyas gamit ang flashlight o matingkad na tela.
5. Kapag nakalabas na, huwag nang bumalik at magtipon sa naplanong tagpuan. Huwag kailanman pumasok sa nasusunog na gusali.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Fire Safety

title: Clothes on fire — Stop, Drop, Roll
text:
1. STOP — do NOT run. Running feeds the flames and makes burns worse.
2. DROP to the ground and cover your face with your hands.
3. ROLL over and over until the flames are out.
4. Cool the burns under clean running water for at least 20 minutes. Cover loosely and seek medical help.
5. If helping someone burning: wrap them in a blanket or coat to smother the flames, then treat the burns.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) / Philippine Red Cross

title: Nasusunog ang damit — Hinto, Higa, Gumulong
text:
1. HUMINTO — HUWAG tumakbo. Pinapalakas ng pagtakbo ang apoy at lumalala ang paso.
2. HUMIGA sa lupa at takpan ang mukha ng mga kamay.
3. GUMULONG nang paulit-ulit hanggang mamatay ang apoy.
4. Palamigin ang paso sa malinis na tumatakbong tubig nang hindi bababa sa 20 minuto. Takpan nang maluwag at magpatingin.
5. Kung tutulong sa nasusunog: balutin siya ng kumot o coat para mamatay ang apoy, saka gamutin ang paso.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) / Philippine Red Cross

title: LPG gas leak at home
text:
1. If you smell gas, do NOT light matches, switch lights on or off, unplug anything, or use your phone inside — any spark can ignite it.
2. Open doors and windows to let the gas out. Do NOT turn on fans that spark.
3. Shut the LPG tank valve (turn clockwise) only if you can reach it quickly and safely.
4. Leave the house at once with everyone, including pets. Keep others from entering.
5. Call the fire station or 911 from outside. Do NOT re-enter until declared safe.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) LPG Safety

title: Tumatagas na LPG sa bahay
text:
1. Kung may amoy gas, HUWAG magsindi ng posporo, magbukas o magpatay ng ilaw, magbunot ng saksakan, o gumamit ng cellphone sa loob — kayang magpaapoy ng kahit anong kislap.
2. Buksan ang mga pinto at bintana para makalabas ang gas. HUWAG magbukas ng bentilador na puwedeng magkislap.
3. Isara ang balbula ng tangke ng LPG (paikot pakanan) kung mabilis at ligtas mong maaabot.
4. Lumabas agad ng bahay kasama ang lahat, pati alagang hayop. Huwag papasukin ang iba.
5. Tumawag sa bombero o 911 mula sa labas. HUWAG bumalik hangga't hindi idinedeklarang ligtas.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) LPG Safety

title: Kitchen oil fire (grease fire)
text:
1. NEVER throw water on burning oil — it explodes into a fireball. Turn off the heat only if you can do so safely.
2. Smother small pan fires by sliding a metal lid or baking tray over the pan. Leave it covered until completely cool.
3. For small fires, throw baking soda at the base of the flames. NEVER use flour, which can explode.
4. NEVER carry a burning pan outside — burning oil sloshes and spreads the fire.
5. If the fire grows or spreads beyond the pan, leave at once, close the door, and call the fire station or 911.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Kitchen Fire Safety

title: Sunog ng mantika sa kusina (grease fire)
text:
1. HUWAG kailanman buhusan ng tubig ang nasusunog na mantika — sasabog ito na parang fireball. Patayin ang apoy ng kalan kung ligtas gawin.
2. Takpan ang maliit na apoy sa kawali sa pamamagitan ng pag-slide ng metal na takip o tray sa ibabaw. Huwag alisin hangga't hindi lubusang lumalamig.
3. Para sa maliit na apoy, sabuyan ng baking soda ang ugat ng apoy. HUWAG gumamit ng harina, na puwedeng sumabog.
4. HUWAG kailanman buhatin ang nasusunog na kawali palabas — tatalsik ang mantika at kakalat ang apoy.
5. Kung lumaki o kumalat ang apoy lampas sa kawali, lumabas agad, isara ang pinto, at tumawag sa bombero o 911.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Kitchen Fire Safety

title: Electrical fire (outlet and wiring)
text:
1. Warning signs before flames: burning-plastic smell, sparks, or blackened or hot outlets — act early.
2. Unplug the device if safe, or cut power at the breaker. NEVER throw water on an electrical fire.
3. Smother small outlet fires with a dry chemical extinguisher, dry sand, or baking soda. NEVER use water or a wet cloth.
4. If fire spreads beyond the outlet: leave at once, close the door, and call the fire station or 911.
5. Prevent it: no octopus connections, no damaged cords, unplug unused appliances, and never run wires under rugs where heat builds.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Electrical Fire Safety

title: Sunog sa kuryente (saksakan at kable)
text:
1. Mga babala bago mag-apoy: amoy nasusunog na plastik, kislap, o nangitim o mainit na saksakan — kumilos nang maaga.
2. Bunutin ang device kung ligtas, o patayin ang kuryente sa breaker. HUWAG kailanman buhusan ng tubig ang sunog sa kuryente.
3. Apulahin ang maliit na apoy sa saksakan gamit ang dry chemical extinguisher, tuyong buhangin, o baking soda. HUWAG gumamit ng tubig o basang tela.
4. Kung kumalat ang apoy lampas sa saksakan: lumabas agad, isara ang pinto, at tumawag sa bombero o 911.
5. Iwasan ito: bawal ang octopus connection, sirang kable, bunutin ang hindi ginagamit na appliances, at huwag padaanin ang kable sa ilalim ng rug kung saan naiipon ang init.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Electrical Fire Safety
